title: The Voice That Refused Despair
intro: Step into a household where loss follows loss, yet one calm voice refuses despair. A single call in the Qur'an turns patience into a turning point; can you trace the clues to the person behind that voice?
clues: I was the voice of patience within a household where blessings were tested by calamity.
I remained in a household emptied by the loss of wealth and children.
I knew that illness had also struck that companion, whose body was afflicted.
When the distress became severe, I called out with a reminder of Allah.
I offered one declaration: Allah is the Truth, so remain patient.
I called to Ayyub by name; afterward, Allah removed the affliction and restored the family.
